data.yaml:
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  evaluation_interval: 15s
rule_files:
  - /etc/prometheus/rules/*.rules
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: node_exporter
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['vcp-pro.tidb.vcpinner.cn:9100', 'ehome.mysql.ehomeinner.cn:9100']
  - job_name: mysqld_exporter
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['10.214.0.10:9104']
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets: ['10.214.0.9:9093']
